name: Foley Railroad Museum
desc: A 24 by 60 foot O-gauge layout built by the volunteer Caboose Club, housed in an annex to the restored 1909 L&N depot.
hours: Model train exhibit Tue, Thu and Sat, about 10 a.m.-2 p.m.; free (check the city site)

name: Golden State Model Railroad Museum
desc: A massive 10,000-square-foot facility featuring functioning models of classic California railroad eras.
hours: Sundays April-December, noon-5 p.m.

name: Pasadena Model Railroad Museum
desc: Home of the Sierra Pacific Lines, a 70 by 72 foot HO layout. The club now operates in Los Angeles.
hours: Open to the public quarterly; next open house Nov 14-15, 2026

name: San Diego Model Railroad Museum
desc: 27,000 sq. ft. of incredibly detailed HO and N scale layouts modeling historic California rail lines.

name: South Bay Historical Railroad Society
desc: Located inside the historic 1863 Santa Clara depot, with two operating HO and N scale layouts.
hours: Tue 5-8 p.m. and Sat 10 a.m.-4 p.m.; free

name: Colorado Model Railroad Museum
desc: A 5,500 sq. ft. masterpiece featuring a floor-to-ceiling mountainous logging layout.
hours: Thu-Mon, generally 10 a.m.-4 p.m. (Sun noon-4); closed Tue-Wed; check seasonal hours

name: Rockledge Model Railroad Museum
desc: A 3,000 sq ft HO layout with over 900 feet of track, recreating 1950s Pennsylvania and Reading rail lines. Home of the Gatsme Model Railroad Club (est. 1952).
hours: Second Saturday of each month, 12-3 p.m.; Toys for Tots free-admission days in Oct-Nov

name: Griffin Museum of Science and Industry
desc: Home to 'The Great Train Story' depicting the winding rail journey between Seattle and Chicago.

name: National New York Central Railroad Museum
desc: A New York Central history museum in a former freight house, with a model train room and outdoor rolling stock.
hours: Wed-Sat, 10 a.m.-5 p.m.

name: Historic RailPark and Train Museum
desc: Houses a phenomenal permanent HO-scale layout capturing local Kentucky rail history.
hours: Daily 10 a.m.-4 p.m. (Wed-Sun in Jan-Mar)

name: National Museum of Railroad History & Innovation (B&O Railroad Museum)
desc: Houses a massive HO-scale layout highlighting the engineering feats required to cross the Appalachians.

name: Wenham Museum
desc: A children's and history museum whose Bennett E. Merry Train Gallery features 10 operating model layouts.
hours: Wed-Sat 9-4

name: Twin City Model Railroad Museum
desc: An O-scale layout packed with recognizable local landmarks and historical accuracy from the 1930s.
size: 11,000+ sq ft; includes a 30 x 50 ft O-scale layout
hours: Mon and Fri 10-3, Sat 10-2, Sun 10-5; Night Trains Sat 3-7 (seasonal)

name: TrainTastic
desc: A massive 50,000 sq. ft. facility featuring monumental, state-of-the-art interactive layouts.
hours: Tue-Thu 10-4, Fri-Sat 10-5, Sun 1-5

name: Iron Spike Model Train Museum
desc: One of the Midwest's premier model train attractions featuring massive, intricate N-scale and operating layouts.
hours: Wed-Thu 10-3, Fri 12-5, Sat 10-5, Sun 12-5; closed Mon-Tue

name: Northlandz
desc: Features 8 miles of miniature track and towering canyon bridges that reach up to three stories high.
hours: Daily 10 a.m.-6 p.m.

name: Bullthistle Model Railroad Museum
desc: A regional gem featuring multiple scales preserving New York's local rail history.

name: Medina Railroad Museum
desc: Located inside a massive wooden freight depot boasting a colossal 2,040 sq. ft. HO-scale layout.

name: Apple Valley Model Railroad Club
desc: A 22 by 100 foot operating HO layout inside the historic 1902 Hendersonville depot, modeling western North Carolina.
hours: Verify before visiting: the club website was last updated in 2020

name: Smoky Mountain Trains Museum
desc: An operating layout plus about 7,000 Lionel engines, cars and accessories, at the Great Smoky Mountains Railroad depot.
hours: Free with a train ticket; otherwise $9 adults, $5 ages 3-11

name: Cornerfield Model Railroad Museum
desc: One of the largest family-owned O-Gauge layouts in America featuring beautifully crafted rolling hills.

name: Columbia Gorge Model Railroad Historical Society
desc: A breathtaking HO-scale layout that mirrors the topography of the Columbia River Gorge in the 1950s.
hours: Public shows in the fall; 2026 dates are Nov 14, 15, 21, 22, 28, 29 and Dec 5, 6 (timed tickets)

name: Train Mountain Railroad Museum
desc: The world's largest miniature railroad, spanning 2,200 acres with over 35 miles of track.

name: Carnegie Science Center
desc: Houses the 'Miniature Railroad & Village,' perfectly capturing Western Pennsylvania in the late 1800s.

name: Choo Choo Barn
desc: A handcrafted 1,700 sq ft layout with 17 operating trains and more than 180 animated figures and vehicles.
hours: Daily 10 a.m.-5 p.m.

name: Lehigh & Keystone Valley Model Railroad Museum
desc: One of the largest layouts recreating the historic routes of the Lehigh Valley railroads.

name: National Toy Train Museum
desc: Run by the Train Collectors Association, with five operating layouts and toy trains dating from about 1840.

name: Western PA Model Railroad Museum
desc: A 40 by 100 foot representation of the B&O line between Pittsburgh and Cumberland, set in the summer of 1952.
hours: Annual Holiday Train Display opens Nov 7, 2026 (mid-November to mid-January)

name: New Braunfels Railroad Museum
desc: Four model railroad layouts in several scales inside a renovated 1907 depot, beside an active Union Pacific main line.
hours: Wed-Sun 10-4

name: Ratcliffe Transportation Museum
desc: Features an 80-by-26-foot O-scale model railroad meticulously recreating Pulaski in 1955.

name: Washington State History Museum
desc: Features an HO-scale layout recreating Washington's rail network with a massive Tacoma Union Station.
size: 15 x 68 ft (1,700 sq ft); 580 ft mainline

name: Fairplex Garden Railroad
desc: A volunteer-run outdoor G-scale garden railroad on the LA County Fairgrounds, running trains across a 100 by 300 foot site that depicts California history.
hours: Free public run days the second Sunday of each month, 11 a.m.-4 p.m., weather permitting; also daily during the LA County Fair

name: Central Iowa Railroad Club (Iowa State Fairgrounds)
desc: A three-deck HO layout with a 392-foot double-track mainline (about 6.5 scale miles) and a replica of the Kate Shelley High Bridge.
size: About 104 x 19 ft (roughly 1,970 sq ft footprint), three decks
hours: Open during the Iowa State Fair; free open house the last Friday of the month, 7-9 p.m.

name: Maine Central Model Railroad (Seashore Trolley Museum)
desc: An HO layout of the Maine Central Railroad built by Helen and Buz Beal and moved to a purpose-built hall in 2024, with over 500 rail cars and 200 switches.
size: 1,640 sq ft; about 3,000 ft of track
hours: Open year-round; Thursday-Saturday in winter. Check the museum for current hours

name: Union Station Model Train Gallery
desc: Volunteer-built gallery running 80+ trains in eight scales from Z to G. It nearly doubles in size for the holidays.
size: 8,000 sq ft (about 10,000 sq ft at the holidays)
hours: Daily 9 a.m.-5 p.m., subject to change; free, $5 suggested donation
